name: Video Editor Pro Max
description: AI-powered video generator that respects your project's brand identity. Creates videos from scratch or edits existing footage with automatic captions, greenscreen support, and smart scheduling.
longDescription:
Convert your project into a video powerhouse. Editor Pro Max analyzes your brand (colors, fonts, tone), suggests video ideas, and creates professional videos automatically.

Features:
- Automatic brand identity detection
- Interactive video creation flow
- Single or recurring videos (1-3/day)
- Greenscreen support for post-editing
- Automatic video history to prevent repetition
- Smart folder scaffolding
- Multi-platform ready (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube)

commands.description: Create and manage AI-powered videos with brand intelligence

subcommands.name: schedule
subcommands.description: Schedule recurring videos (1-3/day) with content variation

subcommands.name: analyze
subcommands.description: Analyze project and show video suggestions based on brand

subcommands.name: history
subcommands.description: View video history and avoid repetition
